Author of Unfollowing Mum

Who this class is for

For cycle breakers. No judgement, no pressure.

  • Parents who want to raise their children differently from how they were raised.
  • People pleasers who find it hard to say no to family, and want words that actually work.
  • Adults weighing up contact, low contact or no contact, who want a calm way to think it through.
  • Anyone who loved Unfollowing Mum or the podcast and wants to go a step further, live.

Here’s what you’ll learn

Five things we’ll cover in 60 minutes

Why family patterns repeat

How the way we were parented quietly shapes how we react, and why spotting a pattern is the first step to changing it.

The people-pleasing loop

Why “keeping the peace” feels safer than saying no, and what it costs over time.

Boundaries that hold

Simple, calm scripts for the conversations that usually end in guilt, plus what to do when a boundary gets pushed.

Contact, low contact or no contact

A clear way to think through your options, without anyone telling you what you should do.

Being the parent you wish you’d had

Small, everyday shifts that help cycle breakers parent from choice, not from habit.

Meet Harriet

Hi, I’m Harriet Shearsmith

I’m an author, a coach and a trainee psychotherapist, and I support cycle breakers: people who have decided the patterns they grew up with stop with them.

I wrote Unfollowing Mum: Break unhealthy patterns and be the parent you wish you’d had, and I host the Unfollowing Mum podcast. I know this work from the inside, which is why I teach it with warmth and without judgement.

Questions

Before you save your seat

Is this therapy?

No. It’s an educational coaching class. It isn’t therapy or medical advice and doesn’t replace support from your GP or a qualified therapist.

Will I have to speak or be on camera?

No. Cameras stay off for attendees, and you can send questions anonymously in the chat.

What if I can’t make it live?

Every seat includes the replay, so you can watch when it suits you.

Is it really free?

Yes. Save your seat with your first name and email.

Script 1 · “The phone call”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Why do so many grown adults still dread one particular phone call?”

Body

“Because most cycle breakers were never shown what a calm boundary sounds like. So they either say yes and resent it, or say no and spend three days feeling guilty. There’s a middle way, and it’s a skill you can learn.”

CTA

“I’m teaching it in a free live masterclass, with the exact scripts. Replay included. Tap Sign up to save a seat.”

Shot: talking to camera, holding a phone that buzzes in the first second. On-screen text: “the call you dread”.

Script 2 · “I wrote the book”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“I wrote a whole book about parenting differently from how you were raised.”

Body

“And the question readers ask me most isn’t ‘why’. It’s ‘how’. How do I set a boundary without a row? How do I decide about contact? How do I stop repeating things I promised I never would? So I’m answering those live.”

CTA

“The Cycle Breaker Masterclass is free. Cameras off, questions anonymous. Tap Sign up.”

Shot: holding a copy of Unfollowing Mum, cream background with the rainbow arrow graphic. Caption: “Educational content, not medical advice.”

Script 3 · “Three sentences”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Three sentences cycle breakers can use when family pushes a boundary.”

Body

“One: ‘I’m not able to do that.’ Two: ‘I’ve answered, and I’m not going to explain again.’ Three: ‘I’m going to end the call now, and we can talk another time.’ No drama, no essay. In my free class I go through when to use each one, and what to do next.”

CTA

“Free, live, with a replay. Tap Sign up below.”

Shot: talking to camera, each sentence appears as a numbered caption in coral, yellow and lilac.
